**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The IP package at §14, read with §13.2 and §15.1, hits our preferred position:

- **§14.1** — Customer owns all Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information, Customer-provided material and pre-existing/independently developed IP; Vendor gets only a limited processing right.
- **§14.2** — Deliverables vest in Customer on creation, with a present assignment from Vendor plus personnel assignments and further-assurances.
- **§14.3** — Vendor retains only Vendor Technology, and anything embedded in or needed to use a Deliverable is back-licensed via the §13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence (including modify/derivative-work and contractor rights).
- **§14.4** — no joint ownership absent a signed instrument; Customer keeps unrestricted rights in its own feedback.
- **§15.1** — no sale of Customer Data, no advertising use, no model training without consent.

Noted for awareness only (not deviations): the §14.2 ownership trigger is conditioned on payment of applicable Fees, and the §1.3 Customer Data definition carves out anonymized operational telemetry that cannot be linked to Customer or an individual.
